section_summary.extract_value: This section details the follow-up analyses conducted to determine the best-fitting model for interpreting results, comparing Model 1 and Model 2 using various statistical approaches. These methods included AIC, BIC, Likelihood Ratio Test, bootstrapping confidence intervals, Bayesian multilevel modeling, and simple slopes analysis. The analyses consistently supported a significant Age×Gender×Gratitude interaction effect, highlighting that gender differences in loneliness were significant for younger, more grateful individuals and older, less grateful individuals. Figure 2, which is not provided, is referenced to illustrate the confidence bands of the gender effect on loneliness.
